[[File:SevenTowers-WoTComics.png|alt=The ruins of the Seven Towers of Malkier from the Wheel of Time comics. (Issue #32)|thumb|The ruins of the Seven Towers of Malkier from the Wheel of Time comics. (Issue #32)]]
The '''Seven Towers''' refers to the seven towers on the walls of the capital of [[Malkier]], a [[Borderland]] nation lost to [[The Blight]]. The Seven Towers were located alongside some lakes near the [[Mountains of Dhoom]]. Today it's only a broken ruin.
<br>
According to [[The Wheel of Time Companion]] the Seven Towers were defining landmarks of Malkier and were broken by the [[Shadowspawn]] armies.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Seven Towers}}
